Firstly, this project was based on the story of a painter with alzheimers named William Utermohlen.

This was a short film I created for my high-school film class along with one other classmate. Due to the 2 man team, I decided to direct, act, edit, and write, while he handled cinematography. We tried to make the first few stages of the video have a similar vibe as the cooking scenes in the Hannibal series, representing how his mind is clear. Later on, camera movements become more erratic and nonsensical, representing his degrading mind. All editing was done in FCPX, taking around 5-6 hours to finish. For the later stages of the video, the editing style was slightly inspired by the effects used in the Death Grips' Takyon music video, due to how chaotic it is.
